title: HolderState, codec 1
description: NON-NORMATIVE. The stored state of an @real-life/trust-protocol holder at codec 1 (lib/src/codec.ts): the library's storage format, not a protocol artifact. lib/src/holder-state-v1.ts is generated from it (scripts/build-holder-state-types.mjs). Not expressible here and checked by the codec alone: a record's id equals its key (contacts, relationships, groups, duties, rotations, prompts, acts, roster, invitations, records, introductions, offers, challenges), and an envelope's rkid equals its recipient's keyAgreement.

Dec.description: a counter as a canonical decimal string

Millis.description: milliseconds since the epoch, a safe non-negative integer

StarOut.description: the sender side of one reconciled sequence (5.4); snapshot and snapshotDigest are null together

GroupStarOut.description: the sender side of one reconciled sequence (5.4); snapshot and snapshotDigest are null together

Tuple.description: one enactment's tuple of a relationship (Trust 6.4)

Contact.description: one entry of the deliverable set (Trust 2120, 2140); its id equals its key

OutboxItem.description: an issued document; its envelope's rkid equals recipient.keyAgreement (not expressible here, checked by the codec)

UnknownDuty.description: a duty of a kind or version this library does not handle: kept as it is

Group.description: a group the holder is in; a listed group carries memberAnchor and memberOp (Trust 5400)
